description_en: Queries sandbox instances that are created within an account

name: DescribeSandboxInstances

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the backup schedule. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437215.html operation to obtain the ID of the backup schedule.

If your instance is an ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL instance, you can https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193091.html to automatically add the instance to DBS and obtain the ID of the backup schedule
parameters.help_zh:
备份计划ID，您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/437215.html接口获取该参数。
若您的实例为RDS MySQL，请通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/193091.html功能，将RDS自动添加至DBS中，即可获取备份计划ID
